EmailTemplate.name: Sorry, Account Not Qualified - Below $500K Revenue (Travel)
EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your interest- until next time!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Thank you for considering Flywire for your payment processing needs. Regrettably, we currently require new clients to have a minimum annual payment volume of $500,000 USD.
This decision is based on resource allocation and our commitment to provide the best service to our clients. While we can't proceed as your payment processor now, we value your interest and hope to be able to assist in the future as we expand our capabilities.
If you believe this email is in error or that you do meet our minimum threshold, please reach out to travelpayments@flywire.com <[[mailto:travelpayments@flywire.com]]> to discuss further.
Need help with a payment? Flywire's support team is available! Contact Support <[[https://help.flywire.com/hc/en-us]]>.
